cards.title: Core schemas and entity architecture of Plant Maintenance
cards.body:
The Plant Maintenance module operates within the EAM enterprise asset management schema.
Equipment master entities reside in EAM.EAMEquipmentMaster and linked detail tables.
Maintenance orders persist within EAM.EAMMaintenanceOrder and EAM.EAMOrderTaskDetail.

cards.title: Spares reservation interface into the Inventory schema
cards.body:
Maintenance order item requirements integrate with the Material Management Inventory schema.
Requisitions write to Inventory.IIndentRequisition referencing MaintenanceOrderId.
Parts issues from Inventory.IMaterialIssue decrement stores balances and update equipment maintenance costs.

cards.title: Standardized EAM stored procedure naming and execution architecture
cards.body:
Plant maintenance backend operations follow standardized stored procedure prefixes.
Master maintenance operations execute through EAM.EAEMSave, EAEMLoadData, and EAEMDelete.
Order processing procedures invoke EAM.EAMOSave, EAMOLoadData, and EAMODelete.
Execution errors return structured exception parameters handled by the application framework.

cards.title: Meter reading triggers and scheduled occurrence generation
cards.body:
Meter entries update cumulative values within EAM.EAMRunningHoursDetail.
Stored procedures evaluate parameter alert thresholds and trigger automatic schedule occurrences.
Schedule generation algorithms calculate due dates from running hours and calendar frequencies.

cards.title: Optimistic concurrency locking and authorization controls in PM
cards.body:
PM entities enforce optimistic locking using ModifiedDate and ModifiedBy record stamps.
Concurrent edits trigger reload warnings to prevent overwriting conflicting updates.
Authorized orders lock scheduling dates, resource assignments, and equipment references.
